evidence.description: Accessing the shared singleton instance of EcosiaBrowserWindowAuthManager.

candidates.explanation: The component directly accesses the `EcosiaBrowserWindowAuthManager.shared` singleton instance to dispatch state changes, creating an implicit dependency that is difficult to isolate or substitute during testing.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Mutable property `isLoggedIn` defined in the class.
Mutation of `isLoggedIn` within `setupTokensWithCredentials` called by multiple async methods.

candidates.explanation: The `isLoggedIn` property is a mutable instance state that is accessed and modified from multiple concurrency contexts (e.g., `login`, `logout`, `retrieveStoredCredentials`) without any visible actor isolation or synchronization.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: Establishment of `isLoggedIn` state followed by an `await` call.

candidates.explanation: In `retrieveStoredCredentials`, the method reads/modifies `isLoggedIn` and then suspends at `dispatchAuthStateChange`. The subsequent `dispatchAuthStateChange` call (or any other logic using `isLoggedIn`) assumes the state remains unchanged across the suspension point without re-validation.
candidates.title: Unsafe Actor State Assumption After Suspension
